visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person with long red wavy hair lies prone on a dark grey gym floor, appearing to be a woman from behind. They wear a white t-shirt and purple leggings. A barbell with large black plates is balanced on their lower back. The background features various red and black gym benches under bright studio lighting. (2) The same person remains prone on the gym floor while the weight of the barbell on their back is updated via text. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the rubberized flooring and the metallic sheen of the barbell. (3) A man with medium-length brown hair and no beard appears indoors against a plain white wall. He wears a blue textured t-shirt and holds a red shaker bottle, displaying a wide-eyed, surprised facial expression with an open mouth. (4) Back in the gym, the person with red hair continues to lie prone. The environment remains static with gym equipment in the background. The central object is the barbell resting on the individual's lower body, and yellow text overlays are visible. (5) The person on the floor begins to move, pushing themselves up with their hands. As they turn, a beard and glasses become visible on their face, creating a visual mismatch with the long red feminine wig they are wearing. (6) Now sitting upright on the floor, the man in the red wig touches his forehead with his hand. He wears thick-rimmed glasses and a white t-shirt. The gym background is slightly out of focus but shows heavy weightlifting equipment. (7) The man abruptly pulls the red wig off his head, revealing he is completely bald. He looks directly into the camera with a serious, intense gaze while the wig lies discarded on the floor beside his legs.
